name: nightcrawler
description: nightcrawler watches marketplaces and shops for new, used and refurbished products. Watchlists run on a schedule; listings are filtered by real specs read from the titles (brand, storage, RAM, CPU, screen, ...) like on Geizhals, with price history, price-drop and sold detection, a deal score and notifications through Apprise (Discord, Telegram, ntfy, e-mail, ...). Sources: the official eBay Browse API (free developer keys), any Shopify store, and any other shop through CSS selectors. Optional AI with your Claude Pro/Max subscription: relevance filter per watchlist in plain language, natural-language search, deal check. Get a token in the container console with: claude setup-token. Then paste it into the template or into Settings > AI in the web UI. Open the web UI after the start. A demo source with test data is set up on the first start. Watchlists, sources and settings are managed in the web UI and stored in appdata.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Database, settings and the Claude login. Back this up.

variables.name: Claude subscription token
variables.description: Optional, for the AI features. Run claude setup-token in the container console and paste the sk-ant-oat... token here (or in Settings > AI).

variables.name: Username

variables.name: eBay enabled
variables.description: Enable the eBay source on the first start (later: Sources page in the web UI). Needs the two keys below.

variables.name: eBay client ID

variables.name: eBay client secret

variables.name: Anthropic API key
